## Checklist

- [ ] Cites the requirement IDs and ADR it serves
- [ ] New rules, thresholds or classification steps have a test that pins them
- [ ] `npm test` was run and passes (or: not run, with the reason)
- [ ] Docs affected by the change are updated
- [ ] No keys, tokens, real logs, usernames or real paths in code, fixtures or docs
- [ ] Nothing writes inside a harness directory; no network calls; no non-determinism
